name: The Pledge of Earth
description: A cut bank of raw clay, worked and reworked until the face of it is a wall of hands. The pledge was made here and the ground has kept the shape of it. Everything is the same red-brown, including the air.

pois.label: Wall of hands
pois.text: Pressed palms, thousands, in rows that overlap and go up out of reach. The lowest are small. The highest are not.

pois.label: Pledge stone
pois.text: Set into the clay and not cut from it. The letters are shallow and filled with the same clay, so you read them with your fingers before your eyes.

pois.label: Clay pit
pois.text: Where the bank was dug. Water has come in and gone grey. A shape sits under it at the depth where you stop being able to tell shape from shadow.
